Kit summary

Fist RushBasic
Deals 2 stages of 140% ATK DMG each to a single enemy, the first stage reduces the target's Turn Meter by 15%, the second stage removes 1 layer of random buff from the target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Feebleness II] for 2 turns.
Steel FistsActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Restores all allies' HP by 15% of Muhamrid's Max HP, and grants all allies a [Shield] equal to 60% of Muhamrid's Max HP, up to 2 layers.
Mechanical Fists Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, Muhamrid casts Steel Fists 1 extra time. Before Loaded Punch deals DMG, removes all buffs from the target.
Mechanical Fists Lv.3For every 1 ally with the [Direct DMG] deployed, reduces all allies' Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG taken by 10%. If 5 allies with the [Direct DMG] are deployed, increases the DMG reduction effect above by 15%, and changes the [Shield] granted by Steel Fists to [Iron Fist Shield], up to 2 layers. After the ally with the highest initial ATK deals DoT, increases their Direct DMG by 50% and Crit DMG by 120% for 1 turn.
Finishing BlowPassiveExclusive Lv.1
When Muhamrid takes Active Skill DMG from enemies (excluding pursue-and-attacks and counterattacks), he will cast Fist Rush to counterattack the attacker once. Muhamrid increases self Effect Hit by 60% of self initial Healing Effect, up to 130% Healing Effect can be calculated. Muhamrid increases DMG dealt and ATK for the 2 allies with the highest initial ATK by 36% of Muhamrid's initial Healing Effect, up to 130% Healing Effect can be calculated.
Mechanical Fists Lv.1At the beginning of each wave, increases self Turn Meter by 30%. If Muhamrid is the ally with the highest initial SPD, when an ally's turn ends, resets the duration of all buffs on the ally.
Loaded PunchActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants all allies [SPD Up II] for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 460% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 100% chance to inflict [Tenacity Down II] for 2 turns.
Mechanical Fists Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, Muhamrid casts Steel Fists 1 extra time. Before Loaded Punch deals DMG, removes all buffs from the target.
